notes.subject: katim ol i go ausait long ol manmeri bilong en
notes.rationale: כרת i tok bilong katim; long hia em i min rausim ol man long graun, olsem na mi usim tok bilong D4c.

notes.subject: ובוגדים
notes.rationale: 'ol i no trat' (treacherous) o 'ol man i stolim' (act covertly); JPS 'faithless', KJV 'transgressors'.

translation: Tasol ol man nogut bai ol i katim ⟨את⟩ ol i go ausait long ol manmeri bilong en, na ol i no trat long graun, ol bai rusum ⟨את⟩ ol i go ausait long em.

tokens.gloss: bai katim ol i go ausait long ol manmeri bilong en
bai rusum ol i go ausait
